choices.rationale: Correct. The annual survey must include tests ensuring the facility meets annual QA requirements and the weekly phantom image quality test.

choices.text: Only the receptionist phone script audit
choices.rationale: Not part of the physicist survey scope.

choices.text: Only USPSTF age-eligibility counseling
choices.rationale: Screening counseling is not the physicist survey requirement cited here.

choices.text: Only social-media marketing review
choices.rationale: Irrelevant to QC survey scope.

questions.explanation: The annual medical physicist survey must include tests ensuring the facility meets the annual QA requirements in (e)(5) and (e)(6) and the weekly phantom image quality test in (e)(2).

variants.simpler: The annual survey still covers the weekly phantom test.
variants.example: Physicist survey paperwork that ignores phantom QC is incomplete.

questions.stem: Where does this module put manufacturer/ACR pass-fail tables for digital SNR/CNR and MTF?

choices.text: Link-only to ACR DMQC or manufacturer manuals; not redistributed as scored tables here
choices.rationale: Correct. Digital SNR/CNR/MTF tables remain link-only manual content.

choices.text: Fully reprinted with numeric cut-scores for every vendor
choices.rationale: Those tables are not redistributed here.

choices.text: Replaced by a single universal 50% SNR rule invented for the course
choices.rationale: Invented cut-scores are forbidden.

choices.text: Ignored because physicists never evaluate digital units
choices.rationale: Physicists do evaluate digital units; the detailed tables just stay in the manuals.

questions.explanation: SNR/CNR, MTF, and related digital-specific physicist metrics are specified in the ACR Digital Mammography QC Manual or manufacturer QC materials and are not redistributed as pass/fail tables in this module.

variants.simpler: SNR/CNR/MTF cut-scores stay in the QC manuals.
variants.example: Use your unit's ACR/manufacturer tables during survey prep.

questions.stem: At a purpose level, how does NCI distinguish diagnostic mammography imaging needs from screening when a lump or change is being evaluated?

choices.text: Diagnostic work uses images from more angles than screening
choices.rationale: Correct. NCI states diagnostic mammography requires images from more angles than screening.

choices.text: Diagnostic work always uses fewer images than screening
choices.rationale: Opposite of the cited distinction.

choices.text: Diagnostic work never uses mammography at all
choices.rationale: Diagnostic mammography is still mammography.

choices.text: Diagnostic work replaces all ultrasound forever
choices.rationale: NCI's angle distinction does not abolish ultrasound pathways.

questions.explanation: NCI explains that diagnostic mammography evaluates a lump or other change and requires images from more angles than screening mammography — the purpose-level rationale for multi-view localization/triangulation pathways.

variants.simpler: Diagnostic exams use more angles than screening.
variants.example: A lump workup may add views beyond the standard screening pair.

questions.stem: For MQSA audit definitions, how is a diagnostic mammogram framed relative to routine screening views?

choices.text: As individualized views for symptoms, signs, or abnormal screening findings
choices.rationale: Correct. Diagnostic mammograms are individualized for clinical concerns or abnormal screening results.

choices.text: As an identical four-view set that never changes
choices.rationale: Diagnostic imaging is individualized, not a fixed screening clone.

choices.text: As ultrasound-only encounters with no mammographic views
choices.rationale: The definition still concerns mammographic diagnostic exams.

choices.text: As physicist survey paperwork only
choices.rationale: Not an audit definition of diagnostic mammography.

questions.explanation: MQSA audit definitions treat a diagnostic mammogram as individualized views for symptoms, signs, or abnormal screening findings, which is the regulatory frame supporting multi-view localization/triangulation pathways.

variants.simpler: Diagnostic mammograms use individualized views, not a rigid screening script.
variants.example: A lump workup can add views beyond screening CC/MLO.
